back: Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the revised canonical front sprite of a HARDENED STOUT MEDIEVAL FENCE. Create precisely his corresponding FULL BODY REAR sprite. Image 2 is style and turnaround example only. Preserve image 1 identity and stocky, broad barrel torso, large head, very short sturdy legs, overall height/scale, plum flat merchant cap, dark gray side hair and big sideburns, olive wide collar and cuffs, muted plum coat, boots and props. True rear view, no face, back of cap and head. Mirror the screen direction and props: raised hand pinching silver brooch with teal stone on IMAGE LEFT, lowered hand holding small tied brown coin bag on IMAGE RIGHT. Keep raised hand at same chest height. Back of open coat with broad olive collar, sparse fold/seam lines, loose modest belt fold; belt purse on corresponding far side mostly hidden. Rounded thick uneven black outline, sparse thin interior lines and flat muted fills. Match image 1 approximate canvas 1217x1293, top cap margin 30px, boots at baseline y1280, same centered ground anchor about x610, don't enlarge or shrink him. Preserve stocky silhouette; no long legs or elongated body. Single character fully visible with transparent margins. True RGBA transparency, no ground shadow, scenery, labels or grid.
displeased: Use case: precise-object-edit. INTERNAL face crop, 240x280, from a seasoned stout medieval fence. Change ONLY eyebrows, eyes and tiny mouth to DISPLEASED: brows flatter and slightly knitted, small black eyes unimpressed, tiny mouth downturned. Exact same feature positions and crop registration. The tiny mouth is directly below the nose; preserve chin and cheek elsewhere. Preserve absolutely the rounded nose and entire nose contour, all skin color/texture, old red cheek scar, hair and sideburn boundary, forehead wrinkle strokes and under-eye wrinkle strokes. Simple original small solid black eyes, sparse black eyebrow strokes, small closed black mouth. NO white eyeballs, teeth, open mouth, new shadows, additional wrinkles or extra features. Do not redraw the head or add body. Transparent portions stay transparent. Keep the facial marks thin/simple at the same level as original.
